title: My Sister's Keeper
author: Jodi Picoult
current_text: My Sister's Keeper was pulled from classrooms in Clawson, Mich., in 2008 as too racy for middle school students.

sources.quote:
Picoult, Jodi
My Sister's Keeper
Atria Bks.
Pulled from classrooms in Clawson, Mich. (2008) as too racy for middle school students. The novel is the story of a young girl who sues her parents because they want her to donate a kidney to her sister.
sources.title: Books Challenged or Banned in 2008-2009, by Robert P. Doyle - Illinois Library Association
